'''Indigenous Pincerbeast''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A wild creature infected by Originium. The large beast carries multiple Originium clusters and is capable of ripping apart its prey with its sickle-like frontal limbs.}}

==Overview==
Wildlife creatures that are infected by Originium, Indigenous Pincerbeasts often appear in groups though are also overwhelmed by basic attacks; They have two attack moves, either a frontal cross cut or a leap followed by a claw attack, dealing Physical damage. While preparing an attack, the Originium clusters on their back begin to glow. Sometimes during battle and especially after succesfully landing a hit they will taunt the player by screaming and spitting.
